hover-sensitivity.caption: At the supplied mass, hover requires about 2.545 N per rotor; actual capability is unmeasured.

damping-poles.caption: Educational second-order responses, not tuned drone gains or simulated aircraft trials.

calibration-protocol.caption: Existing 18-pose design separates fitting and evaluation. Fixture uncertainty remains.

calibration-matrix.caption: Coefficients shown are the historical fit candidate, not a new calibration or an instruction to overwrite trims.

calibration-residuals.caption: These residuals include reference/placement error; they are not certified sensor accuracy.

covariance-geometry.caption: Off-diagonal terms show shared variation. Zero covariance does not generally imply independence.

uncertainty-sampling.source: P4 sigma values; Gaussian curves and AR(1) illustrative
uncertainty-sampling.caption: Density shapes are explanatory references, not a claim that the actual noise is Gaussian or unbiased.

boot-gyro.caption: Hardware bias correction and software transform have separate roles; gyro scale/physical axes remain pending.

gyro-bias-noise.caption: Averaging reduces random fluctuation but does not remove an unmodelled residual bias.

kalman-loop.caption: Scalar roll/pitch estimator candidate. Translational acceleration can corrupt the gravity observation.

fusion-versus-average.source: Unbiased observations of the same scalar; known variances
fusion-versus-average.caption: Inverse-variance fusion improves the model variance. Correlation, bias, different units or wrong dynamics invalidate the simple comparison.

kalman-trust.caption: Smoother output is not an independent accuracy result; mean errors and correlation remain.

accel-failure.caption: Python model results, not Gazebo or flight. The candidate is not accepted for dynamic operation.

timing-budget.caption: Historical samples were not a complete PID controller; source hashes and inter-service gaps still matter.

yolo-architecture.caption: Proposed perception-to-control pipeline. Detection is not depth, localization or a collision-free corridor.

navigation-implementation.caption: A bounded C++ A* prototype exists; generalized n-node ROS integration, real localization and physical bridge acceptance remain pending.

perception-limits.caption: Objects, field of view and distances are illustrative, not camera specifications or YOLO detections.

stopping-frames.source: Stopping distance v*tau+v²/(2a); ROS frame concept
stopping-frames.caption: Real braking, latency and localization are unmeasured; speed limits cannot be inferred from this example.

mission-nodes.caption: The dashed node sequence is input geometry; it does not claim obstacle avoidance or a collision-free path.

simulation-proof.caption: A test harness may stimulate inputs and record outputs; it may not secretly move the aircraft to pass.

battery-model.source: 4200 mAh; ideal constant 10 A; divider ratio 5.7
battery-model.caption: This is not measured endurance. Whole-pack monitoring cannot protect each cell; a motor cut in flight causes a fall.

project-brief.caption: Three complementary tasks: the FC stabilizes, the companion navigates, the simulator evaluates.

frames-geometry.caption: L is centre-to-motor distance; a is its horizontal projection. R redirects the body thrust axis into world coordinates.

pid-feedback.caption: Roll/pitch each use an outer angle and inner rate loop. Yaw uses rate feedback; height supplies the vertical-speed loop.

calibration-fit.caption: Known reference poses and measured XYZ means identify a bias vector and response matrix. Hold out a repeat to evaluate residuals.

estimator-control.caption: Estimation supplies feedback; PID supplies control. The estimated height and vertical speed feed PID loops.

ros-pipeline.caption: The companion requests motion; the RP2350 owns stabilization and motor commands. Real localization remains an integration gate.

garden-model.caption: A proposed scene, not a Gazebo screenshot or successful navigation. Obstacles vary between scenarios and are not given to the planner.

handheld-interface.source: Custom RP2040 handheld, not a product photograph
handheld-interface.caption: Two centred sticks, triggers/buttons and status display. Exact mechanical design and gesture mapping remain to select.

communication-contract.caption: Two separate authorities: pilot references and selected-mode companion references. CC1101 secondary links remain reserved.

pid-parallel.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
pid-parallel.caption: Three interpretable terms combine before saturation. Back-calculation returns saturation error to the integral branch.

yaw-height-pid.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
yaw-height-pid.caption: Yaw is rate controlled. A proposed height/climb reference law feeds the vertical-speed PID; its neutral/transition behaviour still needs validation.

nyquist-example.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
nyquist-example.caption: A shows the complete numerical contour: solid +ω, dashed −ω, dotted connecting arcs; 10^-4 ≤ |ω| ≤ 10^6 rad/s. Arrows follow increasing positive frequency. Symmetric-log axes compress distances, not topology. B magnifies −1 on equal linear axes. The integrator makes the branches unbounded as ω approaches zero; full contour closure is shown in appendix A6.

bode-example.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
bode-example.caption: The curves use the same rational model and gains as Nyquist. Markers show phase margin at unity-gain crossover; margins are computed by bracketed root refinement.

nichols-example.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
nichols-example.caption: Grid lines show closed-loop |L/(1+L)| levels for unity negative feedback. Crossing a generic grid line alone does not establish stability; root/winding checks remain separate.

nyquist-contour.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
nyquist-contour.caption: Left: s-plane contour schematic. Right: all four mapped pieces, including the very large origin-indentation arc, with no clipped data. Symmetric-log axes preserve encirclement but not Euclidean distances. ε=10^-4; outer radius10^6; closure near L=0 is tiny. Winding is computed from untransformed complex values.

anti-windup-example.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
anti-windup-example.caption: Synthetic integrator-only experiment: e=1 for2s then0; Kp=0.2, Ki=1, Kd=0, limits[0,0.45], Δt=1ms, Kaw=10/s. No aircraft, sensor, actuator or closed-loop plant is simulated. Units are normalized controller-output units; 0.45 is an example limit, not a flight-tuning result.

stability-surface.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
stability-surface.caption: Each surface point recomputes all five closed-loop poles. Zero is the stability boundary of this assumed rational model, not a measured operating limit.

stats-pipeline.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
stats-pipeline.caption: Measured spread informs an observation-error model only after reference, stationarity, bias and correlation checks. This diagram does not assert independent Gaussian sensor noise.

poles-plane.source: analysis/control-design-example.json and tools/control_design_example.py; no hardware/Gazebo run
poles-plane.caption: Left: the complex pair as gains increase. Right: all five roots for both cases, including the fast real modes. A 2D complex plane displays these quantities directly; no 3D projection is needed.
